# MH-07 — Reserve for an hiker

**Business value:** 955

[Back to index](../README.md)

## User story

As an employee

I want to enter a reservation for an hiker

So that I can accept reservation via other channels than web


## Notes

- It is useful when a party of hiker arrive some time before the meal time and ask to reserve some seats or when someone wants to reserve by phone (or messages).
- The procedure must allow to either quickly enter name and possibly phone or  enter the full details of the hiker, in addition to the reservation details

<!-- Manual clarifications below this line are preserved on regeneration. -->

## Clarifications

The hicker can be:
- already present in the system (can be matched by name, phone or email)
- missing, in this case it is possible to
  - enter the full details a create a regular hiker profile that can later use the system web interface,
  - quickly provide minimal info: name + optional phone, this would lead to a temporary hiker that is not entitled to login and operate via web

If a full hiker account is created, the password is randomly generated, it can be communicated to the hiker e.g. verbally.
They will be forced to change the password on their next login, in any case the hiker can recover their password via email.

There is only one time constraint for employee-made reservations: they cannot be made after the beginning of the time slot.
